people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.
translations.bsb: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these cities, together with their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as Jehovah commanded by Moses.
